meta.name: domain-authority-auditor
meta.description: Use when auditing domain authority, trust, or citation credibility; runs 40-item CITE scoring with veto checks (TRUSTED/CAUTIOUS/UNTRUSTED). Not for page-level content quality — use content-quality-auditor; not for backlink profiling alone — use backlink-analyzer. 域名权威/网站可信度

copy.tagline: 评估网站域名权威与可信度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要评估网站或域名的权威性和可信度。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate website domain authority and trustworthiness
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to assess the authority and credibility of a website or domain.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按 40 项标准评估域名权威性，生成包含每项得分、维度得分、加权总分、关键问题标记和优先改进计划的审计报告，并给出 TRUSTED/CAUTIOUS/UNTRUSTED 结论。
howto.when: 当用户询问域名可信度或引用可靠性时触发，例如“我的网站有多可信”或“评估这个域名的权威性”。

say.text: 审计 example.com 的域名权威性
say.note: Claude 将运行 40 项 CITE 评分并输出报告。

say.text: 对 example.com 做 CITE 域名审计，类型为电商
say.note: 指定域名类型可调整各维度权重。

say.text: 比较 mydomain.com 与 competitor.com 的域名权威

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude evaluates domain authority across 40 standardized criteria, producing a comprehensive audit report with per-item scoring, dimension scores, weighted totals, critical issue detection, and a prioritized action plan, concluding with a TRUSTED/CAUTIOUS/UNTRUSTED verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks about domain credibility or citation trustworthiness, e.g., 'how trustworthy is my site' or 'evaluate this domain's authority'.

say_en.note: Claude runs the 40-item CITE scoring and outputs a report.

say_en.text: Run a CITE domain audit on example.com as an e-commerce site
say_en.note: Specifying domain type adjusts dimension weights.

say_en.text: Compare domain authority: mydomain.com vs competitor.com
